description: Makes every property of `T` optional. Ideal for patches and option overrides.
Makes every property of `T` required, removing `?` and the `undefined` it implied.
Marks every top-level property as `readonly`. Shallow and compile-time only.
`{ [P in keyof T]: ... }` builds a new object type by iterating over the keys of another.
Compiler option that forbids writing `undefined` into optional properties unless their type includes it explicitly.
